description: Answer key for evaluating agent responses to sample conversations

evaluation_criteria.tools_usage: Correct tools must be used for the query type
evaluation_criteria.information_retrieval: Relevant information from knowledge base must be included
evaluation_criteria.response_quality: Response must be complete, accurate, and appropriate in tone

conversations.query: What's my current subscription plan and when is my next billing date?

expected_behavior.notes: This is a straightforward billing inquiry that should be handled entirely by the billing lookup tool

conversations.query: My files aren't syncing on my Mac. I've tried restarting the app but it's still showing a red icon. This is urgent as I need to access these files for a presentation in 2 hours.

response_must_include: Immediate troubleshooting steps from knowledge base
Alternative access method (web portal) as backup
Escalation option if quick fix doesn't work
expected_behavior.tone: Empathetic and urgent, acknowledging the time-sensitive nature
expected_behavior.notes: The red icon indicates a sync error. Agent should provide quick troubleshooting and alternative access methods given the 2-hour deadline

conversations.query: I want to upgrade from Basic to Professional plan. Can you help me with that?

knowledge_base_topics: Plan Comparison > Basic Plan vs Professional Plan
Account & Billing > Can I change my plan?
response_must_include: Key features gained (2TB storage, API access, SSO, etc.)
expected_behavior.tone: Helpful and informative, slightly sales-oriented but not pushy
expected_behavior.notes: Should verify current plan first, then explain benefits and guide through upgrade process

conversations.query: We're experiencing intermittent sync failures across our entire team of 50 users. Some files sync fine, others get stuck at 'uploading' indefinitely. This started after we updated to the latest version yesterday. We've already tried the basic troubleshooting steps.

response_must_include: System status check for any known issues
Escalation to technical team via ticket
Expected response time for enterprise support
expected_behavior.tone: Professional, acknowledging severity, proactive about escalation
expected_behavior.notes: Enterprise-wide issue affecting 50 users requires immediate escalation. This is beyond basic support and needs engineering involvement

conversations.query: I was charged twice this month. I see two $29 charges on my credit card statement but I only have one account. I need this fixed immediately and a refund for the duplicate charge.

response_must_include: Expected timeline for refund (typically 5-7 business days)
Assurance that this will be investigated
expected_behavior.notes: Billing errors require both verification and escalation for refund processing. Customer is rightfully frustrated

common_failures_to_check: Only creating tickets without attempting to solve
Not checking billing when customer email is provided
Missing urgency acknowledgment in time-sensitive queries
Not checking system status for widespread issues
Hallucinating features or information not in knowledge base
Using wrong plan prices or features
Not providing ticket numbers when creating tickets
Overly verbose responses that don't answer the question
